headline: Anand Rathi Wealth Limited files SEBI Regulation 31(4) substantial acquisition disclosure
sum: Anand Rathi Wealth Limited has filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4) (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, indicating a material change in shareholding structure. Party details, acquisition value, and strategic rationale remain undisclosed in publicly available sources as of the filing date.
detail: The disclosure was filed with the National Stock Exchange (NSE) and archived in the NSE corporate actions repository. SEBI Regulation 31(4) mandates that acquiring parties or the target company disclose the identities of acquirers, shareholding thresholds crossed (25%, 50%, etc.), consideration structure, and conditions precedent when a substantial stake is acquired. The specific acquisition details, including the identity of the acquirer, value, timing, and shareholding percentage, are not disclosed in publicly available press or regulatory sources as of the search date.
